readerCopy.headline: Say yes to the invitation you actually want.
readerCopy.body:
Someone reaches out. A plan you genuinely enjoy becomes easy to make. A small creative decision gets a warmer response than expected. The opening may not look life-changing. It can still matter because the connection is pleasant enough to keep following.

Jupiter sextile Venus opens a door through goodwill. Follow what feels good and still makes sense tomorrow. You do not need to accept the invitation just because it is flattering. The useful yes is the one you would still want without the compliment attached.
